rationale: Exact M0 supersedes generic gamma-kernel and chain-budget screens; Phase177 has one narrowly gated extension.
Posterior mean remains canonical; median and trimmed mean diagnose functional instability and cannot be selected case by case.
VB values may locate plausible regions, but pre-M0 MCMC rankings cannot promote an exAL winner.
Matched controls remain an interpretable anchor but are not a post-M0 ranking.
These interventions changed scalar diagnostics without a reliable quantile-grid performance gain.
Old VB feasibility remains informative; any reused map must be reranked under protected exact M0 and independent readouts were not broadly screened.
Do not confound the first post-M0 DESN/tau0 screen with another shrinkage-architecture experiment.
Structured-v is the selected initialization and coarse-pruning method; it does not replace exact-M0 ranking.
M0 is the prospectively frozen exact exAL sampler.
Only the five held cells can enter recovery; Phase174 remains authoritative until Phase180 qualifies replacements.
